summary: TRACK 18.12 — Mission Control Access + Layout Repair: CERTIFIED GO. Backend regression 36/36 PASS in 0.08s. Live super-admin browser walkthrough on the preview URL passed ALL 27 assertions: workspace strip rendered, 8 workspace chips, 8 card actions, 8 sub-nav links — none bounced to /admin/transportation/, no Admin Console/Portal forbidden copy observed inside /transportation-operations/. /transportation-operations/fleet/trucks correctly compat-redirects to /transportation-operations/trucks. Admin doorway parity verified: mc-workspace-trucks at /admin/transportation routes to /admin/transportation/trucks. Dual-doorway prefix-aware contract holds.
critical_code_review_comments: useTxPathPrefix hook in _shared.jsx is the single source of truth for prefix selection — all 5 surface files (MissionControl, _views, _command_queue, TransportationSearch, TransportationWorkspaceShell) import and use it; pattern is sound.

Admin /admin/login form submit at /admin/login did not authenticate the super-admin during the first walkthrough attempt (page stayed on /admin/login). The /sign-in multi-portal flow with the same credentials worked immediately and granted access to both doorways. Not a defect for this track but worth noting for future Admin Console login automation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mission Control workspace strip (data-testid='mc-workspace-strip') with 8 chips and 8 card actions is fully prefix-aware. Live proof recorded under both doorways. If TRACK 18.12 regresses in future, re-run the live walkthrough — chips must keep the URL under /transportation-operations/ when entered via that doorway, and under /admin/transportation/ when entered via the admin doorway. The /sign-in form is the most reliable login path for this super-admin account on preview; the legacy /admin/login form had a flaky first-submit during this run.
rca of the issue: Prior iterations hardcoded /admin/transportation/... hrefs across MissionControl cards, sub-nav, command queue tabs, search results, and right-rail rows. Track 18.12 fix introduces useTxPathPrefix() in _shared.jsx that returns the active prefix (/transportation-operations or /admin/transportation) based on useLocation(); every user-facing href is now built as `${prefix}/...`. Live walkthrough confirms the prefix is correctly preserved in both doorways.
